incidents.name: d3xai proxy exchange() priced from the Pancake pool
incidents.notes: The d3xai proxy's exchange() converts USDT and D3XAT at the PancakeSwap pool rate, so the attacker bought D3XAT through the proxy, pushed the pool price up with 27 throwaway buyers and sold the D3XAT back to the proxy at the inflated rate.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xb8ad82c4771DAa852DdF00b70Ba4bE57D22eDD99 created 2025-07-01T06:27:44Z by 0x13342140a62cb51c052b5a70eb186f40a1725ebf, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x4b63c0cf524f71847ea05b59f3077a224d922e8d; 9 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from last of 9 upgrade events (onchain). 190 BNB x $835.94/BNB at the incident timestamp 1755333865 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $158,829.
